title: Attend by EireTech 360
summary: A multi-company attendance and staff management platform that installs like a mobile app, with geofenced check-ins, leave approvals, reports and attendance-based payroll.
challenge: Growing teams were still tracking attendance on spreadsheets, paper registers and chat messages. Late arrivals, missed check-outs and leave requests were hard to verify, and payroll depended on hours of manual reconciliation every month.
solution: We designed and built Attend, a secure software-as-a-service platform that any company can use from a phone or computer. Staff check in with one tap, managers approve leave and corrections in seconds, and owners get accurate reports and payroll figures calculated straight from real attendance data.
facts: 5 | User roles, from owner to employee
iOS & Android | Installs without an app store
business: Staff check in and out with one tap, on site or working from home, with multiple sessions a day
Optional geofencing only allows check-in within the office area
Late arrivals, half days, overtime and total hours are calculated automatically
Forgotten check-outs are closed automatically and flagged for review
Leave requests with two-step approval (manager, then HR) and automatic yearly balances
Correction requests for missing or wrong entries, approved by a manager or HR
Monthly payroll calculated from attendance, including late penalties and overtime
Company announcements and instant notifications on phones, even when the app is closed
Attendance audits by day, week, month, employee or department, downloadable as PDF or Excel
Fingerprint and Face ID login, light and dark mode, on phone, tablet and desktop
technical: Multi-tenant SaaS architecture with strict per-company data isolation enforced on every API request
Installable Progressive Web App (PWA): home-screen icon, full-screen mode and offline-ready shell
Role-based access control across Super Admin, Company Admin, HR, Manager and Employee
Server-side attendance engine with timezone-aware rules for shifts, grace periods, late marks and overtime
Browser geolocation with configurable office geofences
Web Push notifications to iOS and Android without a third-party messaging service
WebAuthn biometric login alongside email and password with forced first-login reset
Short-lived access tokens with automatic refresh, and a full audit log of sensitive actions
Configurable approval workflows, shifts, holidays, departments and leave policies per company
Server-generated PDF and CSV exports carrying each company's branding
outcome: Attendance, leave approvals and payroll calculations in one platform, with one-tap check-ins and downloadable reports.

title: E360 Inventory Suite
summary: An all-in-one retail platform that brings the till, stock, suppliers, staff, reporting and the online store together on one live database.
challenge: A busy retail shop in Ireland was running its till, stock counts, supplier orders and online sales in separate places. Stock levels drifted out of sync, deals were applied inconsistently, and the owner had no single, trustworthy view of what was happening in the business.
solution: We built E360 Inventory Suite, a custom web-based system used in the browser by the owner, managers and staff. The point of sale, back office and online store share the same products and stock, so every sale, refund and delivery is reflected everywhere instantly, and the owner can see and control it all from one dashboard.
facts: 1 | Shared database for till, stock and online store
6 | Languages, including Irish, Urdu and Arabic
Offline | The till keeps selling if the internet drops
business: Fast point of sale with barcode scanning and quick-sell buttons for unbarcoded items
Cash, card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Revolut, split payments and store credit
Bundle deals such as "any 3 for €18", discount vouchers and held baskets
Partial and full refunds, exchanges and emailed receipts
Keeps trading offline and syncs sales automatically when the connection returns
End-of-shift closing with a cash, card and refund summary for each cashier
Low-stock alerts, printable barcodes and shelf labels, and a full stock history
Supplier purchase orders: create, send and receive in one place
Dashboards and downloadable Excel and PDF reports for every role
Online store with customer accounts, loyalty points, product reviews, deals and a blog
technical: React single-page admin application and a separate customer-facing storefront
Node.js and Express REST API backed by MongoDB, shared by the POS, back office and storefront
Offline-first POS: transactions are queued locally and synchronised when the network returns
Real-time activity updates across devices with Socket.IO
Role-based access control with owner approval workflows for sensitive actions
Hardened authentication with rate limiting and security headers
Activity log with before-and-after values for product and deal edits, plus server-side request logging with retention rules
Multi-currency cost pricing, channel-specific pricing and a single shared stock ledger
Internationalisation in six languages, including right-to-left support for Urdu and Arabic
Cloudinary image hosting and an automated test suite covering sales, refunds, deals, loyalty and the storefront
outcome: One shared stock database connects the till, back office and online store, with an offline-capable point of sale.

title: Cliffs of Puff
summary: A bold, age-verified online store for an Irish vape and CBD retailer, with more than a thousand products across ten categories, seasonal deals and a fast checkout.
challenge: Cliffs of Puff needed an online shop that matched the energy of its brand, handled a large and fast-changing catalogue, and sold age-restricted products responsibly, while making it easy for customers to find their favourite brands and deals.
solution: We designed and developed a fully branded e-commerce website with mandatory age verification, clear category navigation, search, customer accounts and a streamlined checkout. Seasonal campaigns and bundle offers are built in, so the team can launch promotions like the Halloween Ghost Pack without a developer.
business: Distinctive brand-led design that stands out in a crowded market
Mandatory 18+ age verification before customers can enter the store
Ten clear categories, from vape kits and nicotine pouches to CBD edibles
Search by device, flavour or brand, including Elf Bar, Lost Mary, IVG, Aspire and Vaporesso
Customer accounts with login, registration and order history
Deals and seasonal bundles such as "any 3 nic salts for €18"
Best-seller and sale sections that guide shoppers to popular products
Free shipping over €100, fast dispatch and multiple payment options
Newsletter sign-up, blog and clear shipping, returns and privacy pages
Fully responsive shopping on phone, tablet and desktop
technical: Custom storefront with a responsive, mobile-first design system
Age-gate on entry for regulatory compliance
Catalogue architecture for 1,000+ SKUs across ten categories with brand and flavour search
Cart and checkout flow with order confirmation and customer account area
Promotion engine for percentage discounts and mixed bundle offers
SEO foundations: crawlable category pages, blog, sitemap and legal pages
Performance-focused product imagery and layout for fast mobile browsing
Newsletter capture integrated into the site footer
outcome: A searchable catalogue of more than 1,000 products, with age verification, customer accounts and seasonal offers.

title: Loom Candy
summary: A colourful, sweet-shop inspired online vape store with an 18+ age gate, mix-and-match deals, a helpful blog and a checkout built for quick repeat orders.
challenge: Loom Candy's brand is playful, bright and flavour-led, and the shop needed a website that felt the same way, while still selling age-restricted products responsibly and making a wide flavour range easy to browse on a phone.
solution: We designed a custom WooCommerce theme around the Loom Candy identity, with candy-cloud colours, bold product merchandising and clear category tiles. Built-in bundle deals, a best-sellers rail and a guides blog help customers find the right product, and a mandatory age gate keeps the store compliant.
facts: Custom | WooCommerce theme, built for the brand
business: Bright, brand-led design that matches the Loom Candy logo and packaging
Mandatory 18+ age verification before anyone can browse
Shop by category: vape bars, pod kits, e-liquids, nicotine pouches, coils and pods, and accessories
Mix-and-match "3 for €12" e-liquid offer and vape bar savings, applied automatically
Best-sellers and brand sections that guide shoppers to popular products
Free delivery over €100 and same-day dispatch messaging to boost conversions
Blog with care guides and buying advice that builds trust and search traffic
Newsletter sign-up to bring customers back
Fast, thumb-friendly mobile shopping experience
technical: WordPress with WooCommerce for catalogue, cart, checkout and order management
Custom-built theme ("Candy Cloud") rather than an off-the-shelf template
Product taxonomy for categories, brands and flavour variants
Bundle and discount rules configured for mix-and-match offers
Session-based age-gate modal on entry
Blog and content pages structured for on-page SEO
Responsive, mobile-first layouts with optimised product imagery
outcome: A custom WooCommerce storefront with automatic bundle deals, mobile shopping and a content hub.

title: Candy Ciao
summary: A bold, editorial-style vape store with a striking red-and-black identity, weekly deals, a buying-guide blog and a clean, distraction-free shopping experience.
challenge: Candy Ciao wanted to stand out with a confident, high-contrast brand while keeping the store simple to shop. Customers needed to find products and deals quickly, without the cluttered, discount-heavy look common in the category.
solution: We built a custom WooCommerce theme with strong typography, generous spacing and a "good prices, no visual noise" approach. Clear category tiles, a most-wanted products section, weekly deal cards and an educational blog guide customers from browsing to checkout, behind a mandatory 18+ age gate.
facts: Custom | WooCommerce theme, built for the brand
business: High-impact red-and-black design that reflects the Candy Ciao brand
Mandatory 18+ age verification on entry
Clear "shop by what you need" categories, from vape bars to accessories
Weekly deals such as "3 for €12" e-liquids, plus a dedicated sale section
"Most wanted right now" best-sellers to help shoppers decide faster
Buying guides on the blog, such as choosing a first pod kit
Free delivery on qualifying orders and same-day dispatch messaging
Newsletter sign-up with consent and age confirmation
Responsive layout that shops as well on a phone as on desktop
technical: WordPress with WooCommerce for products, variants, cart and checkout
Custom-built theme ("Candy Commerce") with a reusable section system
Product categories, variants and sale scheduling managed in WooCommerce
Promotion rules for bundle and percentage discounts
Age-gate on entry and consent-aware newsletter form
SEO-friendly blog and category architecture
Mobile-first, performance-minded front end
outcome: A custom WooCommerce storefront with clear category navigation, scheduled offers and buying guides.
